subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the entry vestibule are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. No cost impact is anticipated. This is not holding up any current work. No hard deadline, just would like to keep this moving. It is not clear whether this needs Architect interpretation of what was intended, or just confirmation that the documentation has an error.
